sloka: पाद मूलम् गमिष्यामि तस्य एव अहम् महात्मनः ।यो असौ राम प्रयुक्तेन शरेण विनिपातितः ॥४-१९-१९॥
transliteration: pāda mūlam gamiṣyāmi tasya eva aham mahātmanaḥ ।yo asau rāma prayuktena śareṇa vinipātitaḥ ॥4-19-19॥

translations.english: 'I will seek the soles of the feet of the great soul who has been killed by the arrow discharged by Rama.'
